overall_reason: The idea is 'today's three meetings on a time rail': the time column carries it, but each meeting's people line floats between rows.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE and T-SIGNATURE pass on the time rail; T-SIGNATURE is weakened because the meeting object splits into six evenly spaced rows.

findings.evidence: The people line 'Maya and Jon' sits 27px below 'Design review' and 27px above '11:00 AM', so the eye reads six equal rows, not three meetings (tile 1440-00.png, card x 396-680).
findings.before: Title and people line spaced like separate rows
findings.after: Group each meeting: people line tight under its title, larger gap between meetings
findings.why: The meeting is the object this card exists for; when it splits, the reader has to pair lines by hand.

strengths: The left time column (9:30 AM, 11:00 AM, 2:00 PM) is the signature: a schedule read by time first.
